key_insight: HYSET reframes tool retrieval from ranking individual tools to predicting the best tool set jointly as a hyperedge, capturing compatibility among tools for LLM agents.
engineering_relevance: This can improve real-world agent reliability by selecting smaller, more task-relevant tool subsets before execution, without changing the downstream LLM agent.
method: Formulate tool retrieval as query-conditioned hyperedge prediction on a tool co-invocation hypergraph.
Model set utility directly, including size-dependent tool compatibility via cardinality-specific interactions.
Use HYSET as a pre-selection module that plugs into existing agent pipelines without downstream changes.
evidence_signal: On ToolBench, HYSET outperforms strong baselines in both tool retrieval metrics and end-to-end task success, and it also transfers to held-out tools, categories, and unseen domains with little supervision.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the tool co-invocation hypergraph, so sparse or biased historical tool-use data may limit generalization.
paper_title: Tools Are Not Islands: Set-Level Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents via Query-Conditioned Hyperedge Prediction
